name: New Hampshire

agency.name: New Hampshire Division of Motor Vehicles

gaps: Each city or town adds its own small fees at registration (clerk, municipal agent, transportation improvement fund, waste or parking funds). Only Manchester's list was read on an official page; for other towns the line has no amount.

The municipal permit fee is charged on the maker's list price; when you do not type the MSRP the engine uses the price, which understates it for a used car. A first registration that is shorter or longer than 12 months is prorated by the town.
The state fee applies to the gross weight bands of RSA 261:141 (up to 3,000 lb, 3,001 to 5,000 lb, 5,001 to 8,000 lb); the engine places the car by the weight typed.
The 2026 state fees (title $35, weight fees $42, $48 and $66) were read on a town's official copy of the HB 2 fee table; the DMV's own PDF and the RSA pages blocked automated reading.
The safety and emissions inspection program has been suspended since February 2026 while the state's repeal is litigated in federal court; if the courts restore it, an inspection would be due again.
New Hampshire has no sales tax on vehicles. No dealer documentation fee cap was read in New Hampshire law for this release.

counties.name: Any other New Hampshire city or town

singular: New Hampshire charges no sales tax on cars; the big bill is the municipal permit fee paid to your city or town at every registration [manchester].
The permit fee is $18 per $1,000 of the original list price for a current model year car, then $15, $12, $9, $6 and finally $3 from the fifth year [manchester].
The state part of the registration rose on January 1, 2026 to $42 a year up to 3,000 lb, $48 from 3,001 to 5,000 lb and $66 from 5,001 to 8,000 lb [hb2-2026].
The title fee rose from $25 to $35 on January 1, 2026 [hb2-2026].
Battery electric cars pay a $100 yearly surcharge and plug-in hybrids $50, deposited in the highway fund [manchester].
Manchester adds its own fees: $2 clerk, $3 municipal agent, $3 waste reclamation, $5 transportation improvement and $2 parking trust fund, plus $2 for a title application [manchester].
A set of two standard passenger plates costs $8, once [jackson].
The yearly vehicle inspection program has been suspended since February 2026, and stations no longer issue state stickers [inspection].
Registration starts at the town office, which collects the permit, and the town can then complete the state part as an agent of the DMV [manchester].

inspection.name: NH Division of Motor Vehicles, Inspections & Emissions (public guidance of February 13, 2026)
inspection.quote: The vehicle inspection program is suspended until further notice. Inspection stations will no longer be authorized to issue state inspection stickers and vehicles will not be required to obtain an annual state inspection at this time.

concord.name: City of Concord, Motor Vehicle Registration Fee Changes
concord.quote: The State of New Hampshire has passed its biennial budget, and included in that legislation is a new statewide motor vehicle fee schedule that will take effect on January 1, 2026.
